payload.name: DNS Inspector
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: DNS Inspector looks up the main DNS record types (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA) for any domain and displays them in a clear, readable widget, with one-click refresh and copy-to-clipboard for each value.
payload.longDescription: DNS Inspector 可针对任意域名即时查询主要DNS记录类型（A、AAAA、CNAME、MX、TXT、NS、SOA），并以清晰易读的组件展示结果，每个数值均支持一键刷新和复制功能。

payload.name: Botpress
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Complete AI Agent Platform

Botpress is an all-in-one platform for building AI agents powered by the latest LLMs. Use this application to rapidly prototype agents that can do FAQ, sales, support and so much more!

How it works:
1. Tag @Botpress in your chat and ask ChatGPT to create an agent with Botpress.
2. Iterate on design, business logic, information sources and more through natural language!
3. Once deployed, with the click of a button, you can open your agent in Botpress to access a comprehensive visual agent builder.
payload.longDescription:
完整的AI代理平台

Botpress是基于最新大型语言模型的全功能AI代理开发平台，可通过该应用快速构建可执行常见问题解答、销售支持、客户服务等任务的AI代理！

工作原理：
1. 在聊天中@Botpress，并让ChatGPT使用Botpress创建一个代理。
2. 通过自然语言迭代设计、业务逻辑、信息来源等要素。
3. 部署完成后，点击按钮即可在Botpress中打开代理，使用全面的可视化代理构建工具。

payload.name: Outside Agent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Outside Agent turns a plain-language brief into a hosted AI agent you can publish to SMS, voice, and web without leaving your coding agent. Describe what the agent should do and it composes the full configuration, grounds it in your own content, runs a safety review, and ships it. Create agents, seed a knowledge base, preview replies before publishing, issue a phone number, and manage everything you’ve built, all through natural conversation.
payload.longDescription: 外部代理将简单的简介转化为托管的AI代理,您可以发布到SMS、语音和网络中,而不离开编码代理人。 描述代理人应该做什么,并组成完整的配置,在自己的内容中建立基础,运行安全审查,并发送它。

payload.name: Agent Ready
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Agent Ready checks how readable any website is to AI agents, assistants, and crawlers. Give it a URL and it scans the site against the Vercel Agent Readability Spec, the llms.txt standard, and emerging agent protocols (MCP server cards, A2A agent cards, agents.json), then renders an interactive score card: a 0–100 agent-readability score, an llms.txt score, and a per-check breakdown grouped by site, page, llms.txt, and protocol - each failing check paired with a plain-English fix.

Use it to find out why AI tools can't read your content, validate your llms.txt and AGENTS.md, confirm your structured data and Markdown mirrors, and re-scan any time to check that your fixes landed. Each result links to a full, shareable report on agent-ready.dev. Free to use, no account required.
payload.longDescription:
Agent Ready可检测任意网站对AI代理、助手和爬虫的可读性。输入一个网址，它将根据Vercel代理可读性规范、llms.txt标准以及新兴代理协议（MCP服务器卡片、A2A代理卡片、agents.json）扫描该网站，然后生成交互式评分卡：0-100分的代理可读性评分、llms.txt评分，以及按网站、页面、llms.txt和协议分类的逐项检查明细——每个未通过检查项都会配以通俗易懂的修复建议。

您可以使用它来查明AI工具无法读取您内容的原因，验证llms.txt和AGENTS.md文件，确认结构化数据和Markdown内容的一致性，并可随时重新扫描以确认修复效果。每个检测结果都会链接到agent-ready.dev上的完整可共享报告。免费使用，无需账户。

payload.name: Buildy
payload.description: 为代理打造的个人应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Buildy is a hosted runtime for personal web apps that users and their agents can share. An agent creates an app, Buildy gives it a URL, backend, and key-value storage, and the user keeps using the same app and data across ChatGPT, Claude, and other agents.
payload.longDescription: Buildy是个人网页应用的托管运行时，用户及其代理可以共享此类应用。代理创建应用后，Buildy会为其分配URL、后端服务和键值存储，用户可在ChatGPT、Claude及其他代理间持续使用同一应用和数据。

payload.name: ArmorCodex
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ArmorCodex lets you read, update, and review the policies that govern how AI coding agents interact with tools, files, and infrastructure. Set rules in natural language ("deny webfetch", "require approval for production database changes"), check current policy state, and register intent plans before tool calls run. Built by ArmorIQ for teams that need governance and audit on AI agent activity.
payload.longDescription: ArmorCodex允许您读取、更新和审查管理AI编码代理与工具、文件及基础设施交互方式的策略。通过自然语言设置规则（「拒绝网络获取」、「要求对生产数据库变更进行审批」），检查当前策略状态，并在工具调用执行前注册意图计划。由ArmorIQ开发，专为需要对AI代理活动进行治理和审计的团队设计。

payload.name: Alchemy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Alchemy helps developers inspect EVM and Solana blockchain data, manage Alchemy apps and infrastructure, review usage, and configure webhooks and Gas Manager policies through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Alchemy帮助开发者通过ChatGPT检查EVM和Solana区块链数据，管理Alchemy应用和基础设施，查看使用情况，并配置网络钩子和Gas管理策略。

payload.name: IcePanel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
IcePanel is a collaborative diagramming and modelling tool for software architecture. With IcePanel's MCP, bring your software architecture designs into ChatGPT and Codex.

Some cool things you can do with IcePanel's MCP:
- Understand the systems you're building and data flows
- Create model objects and keep them in sync with code
- Manage architecture decision records and ensure they align with what gets built in reality
payload.longDescription:
IcePanel 是面向软件架构的协作型绘图和建模工具。通过 IcePanel 的 MCP，将您的软件架构设计带入 ChatGPT 和 Codex。

使用 IcePanel 的 MCP 可以实现以下功能：
- 理解您正在构建的系统和数据流
- 创建模型对象并保持与代码同步
- 管理架构决策记录并确保它们与实际构建的内容一致

payload.name: Statsig
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bring your Statsig workspace into ChatGPT. Product builders can now explore, manage, and create Statsig experiments, feature gates, dynamic configs, and more directly in ChatGPT conversations.

Ask things like:
“Move this experiment to 50% rollout.”
“Turn on this feature gate for all users.”
“Show me which dynamic configs changed this week.”
"Explain how the DAU metric is defined.”

You can both read and write to Statsig: inspect experiment settings, read metric definitions, update allocations, toggle feature flags, edit targeting rules, and modify dynamic config values directly from ChatGPT.

The app connects through Statsig’s MCP server and honors your existing Statsig permissions, so you only see and change what you’re authorized to access—across projects, environments, and teams.
payload.longDescription:
将您的Statsig工作区带入ChatGPT，产品开发者现在可以在ChatGPT对话中直接探索、管理并创建Statsig实验、功能开关、动态配置等。

可以询问以下内容：
“将此实验的发布比例调整为50%。”
“为所有用户开启此功能开关。”
“展示本周有哪些动态配置发生了变化。”
“解释DAU指标的定义方式。”

您可直接通过ChatGPT读写Statsig：检查实验设置、查看指标定义、调整分配比例、切换功能标志、编辑定向规则、修改动态配置值等操作均能直接完成。

该应用通过Statsig的MCP服务器连接，并遵循您现有的Statsig权限设置，因此您只能查看和修改被授权访问的内容——涵盖所有项目、环境和团队。

payload.name: Val Town
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Val Town helps users create, inspect, run, and deploy apps; manage files, branches, schedules, environment variables, SQLite data, and blob storage; and debug executions through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Val Town帮助用户创建、检查、运行和部署应用；管理文件、分支、计划、环境变量、SQLite数据和Blob存储；并通过ChatGPT调试执行。

payload.name: MiroMiro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Extract design from any website

MiroMiro lets you pull real design data out of any live website from ChatGPT: brand colors, fonts, logos, design tokens, images, SVGs, and Lottie animations, plus production-ready code rebuilt from actual page sections. Everything comes from the site's real CSS and assets, not screenshots or guesses.

Use it to match a brand, rebuild a section you like, or collect assets for a moodboard, then drop the output straight into your project.

What you can do:

-Extract a complete brand profile from any URL: color palette with roles, fonts, logo and favicon URLs, social profiles, and theme
-Pull a site's design token system (colors, spacing, radii, shadows, typography) as CSS variables or a Tailwind config
-Turn any page section into clean React, Vue, or HTML with Tailwind classes
-List every font a site loads with file URLs, formats, and the CSS stack to replicate it
-Collect all SVG logos and icons as paste-ready code and direct file URLs
-Gather a page's image assets grouped by source (img, srcset, picture, background, favicon, social image) with direct URLs
-Find Lottie animations on a page and get their JSON files

Best for developers, designers, and AI builders who need real design data from live sites instead of eyeballing it.
payload.longDescription:
从任何网站提取设计

MiroMiro让你通过ChatGPT从任何实时网站中提取真实设计数据：品牌配色、字体、Logo、设计令牌、图片、SVG图像、Lottie动画，以及由实际页面区域重构的可直接使用的代码。所有数据均来自网站的真实CSS和资源，而非截图或猜测。

可用于匹配品牌风格、重建喜欢的页面区域或收集情绪板素材，直接将输出结果导入你的项目。

你能实现的功能包括：

- 从任意网址提取完整的品牌档案：带角色的色板、字体、Logo和favicon链接、社交资料及主题
- 以CSS变量或Tailwind配置形式提取网站的设计令牌系统（颜色、间距、圆角、阴影、排版）
- 将任意页面区域转换为带Tailwind类的干净React、Vue或HTML代码
- 列出网站加载的所有字体及其文件链接、格式和CSS堆栈以实现复现
- 收集所有SVG Logo和图标为可直接粘贴的代码及原始文件链接
- 按来源（img、srcset、picture、背景图、favicon、社交图片）分组整理页面图片资源并提供原始链接
- 找到页面中的Lottie动画并获取其JSON文件

适合需要从实时网站获取真实设计数据的开发者、设计师和AI构建者，而非仅凭肉眼观察。

payload.name: 60fps
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
60fps is a library of real iOS app interactions, recorded from shipping apps and broken down so
you can build them.

Search in plain language, like "springy bottom sheet" or "pull to refresh with haptics", and get
back matching shots with the app, the gesture, and the motion vocabulary that describes them. Open
one for a frame by frame breakdown of the animation: what moves, in what order, with what timing
and easing. Where a bespoke recreation exists, you can pull compile-checked SwiftUI for it.

It answers the question a reference video cannot: not just what an interaction looks like, but what
it is actually doing.

Read only. It never writes anything and never acts on your behalf.
payload.longDescription:
60fps是一个真实iOS应用交互的库，这些交互从已发布的应用中录制并拆解，让您能够进行复现。

通过自然语言搜索，例如「弹性底部表单」或「带触感反馈的下拉刷新」，即可获得包含对应应用、操作手势以及描述其运动规律的动效术语的匹配片段。点击任一片段可查看逐帧分解的动画细节：显示对象、运动顺序、时间节奏及缓动方式。当存在定制化复现内容时，可直接获取经过编译检查的SwiftUI代码。

它解决了参考视频无法回答的问题：不仅展示交互的外观，更揭示其实际运行机制。

只读模式。从不写入任何内容，也不会代表您执行任何操作。

payload.name: Honeycomb
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Honeycomb helps users investigate observability data, inspect traces and AI conversations, run queries and BubbleUp analyses, and manage boards, SLOs, triggers, markers, and notification recipients through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Honeycomb 帮助用户分析可观测性数据，检查追踪记录和AI对话，运行查询和BubbleUp分析，并通过ChatGPT管理看板、SLO、触发器、标记和通知接收者。

payload.name: Agiflow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Agiflow is a shared project board for turning plans into trackable work. Create projects, break them into work units and tasks, set priorities and statuses, assign work, add comments and attachments, and review progress across your workspace. Use Agiflow to plan launches, organize backlogs, run standups, triage incoming work, and keep decisions connected to the tasks they affect. Changes are saved to your authenticated Agiflow workspace, where your team can review and continue the work.
payload.longDescription: Agiflow是用于将计划转化为可跟踪工作的共享项目看板。创建项目，将其分解为工作单元和任务，设置优先级和状态，分配工作内容，添加评论和附件，并在您的工作区中审查进度。使用Agiflow可规划产品发布、管理待办事项清单、召开站会、处理待办工作以及确保决策与相关任务保持关联。所有更改都会保存至您的已认证Agiflow工作区，团队成员可随时查看并继续推进工作。

payload.name: Aiven
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Aiven official plugin to provision and manage PostgreSQL, Kafka, and other data services on Aiven. Includes the Aiven MCP Server for project, service, and database management, Kafka topics and connectors, PostgreSQL queries, integrations, and application deployment directly from your AI assistant.
payload.longDescription: Aiven官方插件，用于在Aiven上部署和管理PostgreSQL、Kafka及其他数据服务。包含Aiven MCP服务器，用于项目、服务和数据库管理，Kafka主题和连接器、PostgreSQL查询、集成和直接通过您的AI助手进行应用部署。

payload.name: Testifly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Testifly helps developers, QA engineers, and product teams validate websites and web applications with automated end-to-end (E2E) testing, website checks, and UI validation directly from a URL. Run browser-based tests to verify user flows, page behavior, redirects, availability, performance, accessibility, and overall site health without any setup. Whether you're testing a production site, staging environment, preview deployment, or local environment, Testifly quickly identifies issues before they reach users.

Testifly is especially valuable for AI-assisted and vibe coding workflows, where code is generated rapidly by AI coding agents. As development accelerates, automated end-to-end validation is critical to ensure features actually work in the browser. Testifly provides an independent verification layer that catches broken user flows, regressions, UI issues, and deployment problems that AI-generated code or unit tests may miss.

Integrated with ChatGPT, Testifly lets you create, run, and analyze end-to-end tests using natural language. It works alongside AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, and other coding agents, enabling developers to verify changes continuously without writing test code. Generate structured test reports, validate bug fixes, monitor regressions, and confidently ship high-quality web applications.
payload.longDescription:
Testifly帮助开发者、QA工程师和产品团队通过自动化端到端（E2E）测试、网站检查和用户界面验证直接从URL验证网站和网络应用程序。运行基于浏览器的测试以验证用户流程、页面行为、重定向、可用性、性能、可访问性和整体站点健康状况，无需任何设置。无论您是在测试生产环境、预发布环境、预览部署还是本地环境，Testifly都能在问题影响用户之前快速识别出来。

Testifly对AI辅助和直觉编码工作流尤其有价值，这类工作流中AI编码代理会快速生成代码。随着开发速度加快，自动化端到端验证对于确保功能在浏览器中实际运行至关重要。Testifly提供独立的验证层，能够捕捉AI生成代码或单元测试可能遗漏的断裂用户流程、回归问题、用户界面问题和部署问题。

与ChatGPT集成后，Testifly让您通过自然语言创建、运行和分析端到端测试。它可与Claude Code、Cursor、GitHub Copilot、Windsurf等AI开发工具及其他编码代理协同工作，使开发者能够在不编写测试代码的情况下持续验证更改。生成结构化测试报告，验证缺陷修复，监控回归问题，并自信地发布高质量的网络应用程序。

payload.name: Visily
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring Visily designs into ChatGPT. Find boards and screens, turn Visily designs into responsive application code, and apply board theme tokens to your project. Connect a Pro or Business workspace with an editor license using OAuth, then share a Visily link or ask for a board by name.
payload.longDescription: 将Visily设计导入ChatGPT。查找画板和界面，将Visily设计转换为响应式应用代码，并将画板主题标记应用到您的项目中。通过OAuth连接配备编辑器许可证的Pro或Business工作区，然后分享Visily链接或通过名称请求画板。

payload.name: Sugra API
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sugra API is intelligence infrastructure for AI agents and decision platforms: one key and one normalized format for cross-domain primary-source data, surfaced to agents through the Model Context Protocol. The connector exposes a small, stable tool surface over the full Sugra catalog of more than 1,300 endpoints aggregating 130+ primary sources across data domains including markets, macroeconomics and central banks, corporate filings, public finance, trade flows, agriculture, climate and natural events, maritime activity, prediction markets, global news, network intelligence, and entity screening. Main workflows: discover endpoints by natural-language search and inspect their schemas, run a one-step find-and-call to retrieve data, pull macroeconomic series and central-bank rates, fetch market prices, history and fundamentals through Sugra Finance, screen a person or organization name against sanctions corpora, resolve free text to a canonical entity, and compose a normalized current view or bounded timeseries for an entity with freshness and provenance. Works with Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and xAI model families and any MCP-enabled client. A free Sugra account is the only connection requirement; the read-only surface never writes, deletes, sends, or publishes.
payload.longDescription: Sugra API是AI代理人和决策平台的免费情报基础设施:跨域主源数据的一个关键和一个标准化格式,通过客户端模型协议向代理人表面。连接器在超过1300个端点的完整Sugra目录中展示了一个小而稳定的工具表面,汇集了130多个主源在数据领域,包括市场,宏观经济和中央银行,公司提交,公共金融,贸易流动,农业,气候和自然事件,海洋活动,预测市场,全球新闻,网络智能和实体筛选。主要工作流程:通过自然语言搜索发现130多个主源,检查他们的方案,运行一步式查找和调用以获取数据,抽取宏观经济系列和中央银行,收取市场价格,历史和基础知识,通过Sugra Finance,屏幕一个组织的名称

payload.name: ProductOS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ProductOS is a remote-first, AI-native development platform. Connect ChatGPT to your entire cloud workspace with no local clone needed. Create and manage projects, boot isolated cloud sandboxes with live preview URLs, read and write files, run a full shell (npm, git, node), provision Postgres databases and S3 storage, and trigger production deploys. Every file change auto-syncs to GitHub. Perfect for rapid prototyping, full-stack development, and team collaboration directly from chat.
payload.longDescription: ProductOS 是一个以远程优先、原生AI支持的开发平台。无需本地克隆即可将ChatGPT连接到整个云工作区。创建和管理项目，启动隔离的云沙盒并获取实时预览网址，读写文件，运行完整终端（npm、git、node），配置Postgres数据库和S3存储，并触发生产环境部署。每次文件更改都会自动同步到GitHub。适用于从聊天界面直接进行的快速原型设计、全栈开发和团队协作。

payload.name: microfn
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
microfn is a sandboxed cloud environment for building, deploying, and running tiny JavaScript functions - designed to be AI-friendly. Give ChatGPT its own workspace to write functions, deploy them, manage their code and secrets, and run the functions you've already built.

With microfn, ChatGPT can:

- Write and deploy a new JavaScript function on request
- Inspect, update, and validate the code of existing functions
- Manage function settings and secrets securely
- Run your functions and use their results in the conversation

Each function runs in an isolated sandbox, so ChatGPT can safely create and compose its own tools - fetch a weather API, build a key-value store, post to Slack, send a Telegram message, and much more.
payload.longDescription:
microfn是一个沙箱化云环境，用于构建、部署和运行微型JavaScript函数，专为AI友好设计。为ChatGPT提供专属工作空间，可编写函数、部署函数、管理代码和密钥，并运行已构建的函数。

通过microfn，ChatGPT可以：

- 按需编写并部署新的JavaScript函数
- 检查、更新并验证现有函数的代码
- 安全管理函数设置和密钥
- 运行你的函数并在对话中使用其结果

每个函数都在隔离的沙箱中运行，因此ChatGPT可以安全地创建和组合自己的工具——获取天气API数据、构建键值存储、向Slack发送消息、向Telegram发送信息等更多功能。

payload.name: Descope
payload.description: 为您的应用和MCP添加认证
payload.summaryOriginal: Add auth to your apps and MCPs
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Descope brings a first-class authentication and identity management experience into ChatGPT. Manage users, tenants, roles, and access control across your Descope projects through natural language. Build and modify auth flows for signup, login, MFA, SSO, and federation without leaving the conversation. Configure auth, consent, and credential management for your MCP servers and AI agents, and easily search Descope documentation when you need guidance.
payload.longDescription: Descope将顶级的身份认证与管理体验带入ChatGPT。通过自然语言管理跨Descope项目的用户、租户、角色和访问控制。在对话中即可构建和修改注册、登录、多因素认证（MFA）、单点登录（SSO）及联合身份认证流程。为您的MCP服务器和AI代理配置认证、同意条款及凭证管理，在需要指导时可轻松搜索Descope文档。

payload.name: Brainbase MCP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Brainbase MCP lets users create, inspect, update, test, deploy, and monitor managed AI agents from ChatGPT and Codex. It supports revision-safe agent changes, registry skills and MCP server configuration, evaluations, orchestrations, schedules, and task runs, with explicit confirmation for destructive actions and OAuth-based access to the user's Brainbase workspace.
payload.longDescription: Brainbase MCP允许用户从ChatGPT和Codex创建、检查、更新、测试、部署和监控托管AI代理。该工具支持版本安全的代理更改、技能注册与MCP服务器配置、评估、编排、计划任务及任务执行，并提供对破坏性操作的明确确认，以及基于OAuth的用户Brainbase工作区访问权限。

payload.name: Ezoic Setup

payload.name: @imqueue
payload.description: 搜索文档，生成代码框架
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
@imqueue is an open-source TypeScript framework for building microservices that
talk over a message queue instead of HTTP — you write a class, decorate the
methods you want to publish, and callers get a fully-typed client generated from
the running service.

This server gives your assistant first-hand knowledge of it, so it writes real
@imqueue code instead of plausible-looking code.

search_docs covers the guides, the tutorial, the CLI manual, the articles, and
every exported symbol of every @imqueue package that publishes an API reference —
so you can ask a question in plain words ("how do I expose a service method?") or
look up an exact signature ("RedisQueue.send", "IMQOptions.safeDelivery").
Results carry page URLs, and get_doc returns any page as plain markdown for
reading and quoting. list_packages returns the current package catalogue with
install commands, which is how an assistant picks the right one rather than
guessing at a name. Where two packages cover the same ground — tracing, or the
database layer — the results carry the rule for choosing exactly one, because
installing both breaks quietly rather than loudly.

scaffold_service generates an idiomatic service — an IMQService subclass with
@expose()d, JSDoc-typed methods plus a bootstrap that starts it — from the method
signatures you describe. A custom return type comes back with the @classType() and
@property() decorators it needs, which matters because a field that lacks them
reaches the generated client typed any and still compiles. scaffold_client shows
how to generate and use the typed client for a service. Both return source text
for you to review and paste; neither writes a file.

All six tools are read-only. The server has no accounts, no authentication and no
storage: each request is handled statelessly, and the only data it sees is the
argument you send — a search query, a doc URL, a service name. Nothing is
retained, and no conversation content is collected or used for training.

Tools that would act on your own machine — driving the imq CLI, creating projects
on disk, starting and stopping your services, reading their logs — are
deliberately not part of this server, because a hosted server cannot reach your
machine and should not claim to. They ship in the local install instead
(npx -y @imqueue/mcp), and local_install_guide returns the setup steps for it.
payload.longDescription:
@imqueue 是一个开源的 TypeScript 框架，用于构建通过消息队列而非 HTTP 通信的微服务——您只需编写一个类，用装饰器标记需要发布的方法，调用方将获得从运行中的服务生成的完整类型客户端。

该服务器让您的助手直接掌握其知识，因此能生成真实的 @imqueue 代码，而非看似合理的代码。

search_docs 覆盖指南、教程、CLI 手册、文章以及所有 @imqueue 包的导出符号（包含 API 参考）——您可以用自然语言提问（“如何暴露服务方法？”）或查找具体签名（“RedisQueue.send”，“IMQOptions.safeDelivery”）。结果包含页面链接，get_doc 可返回任意页面的纯文本 markdown 格式以便阅读和引用。list_packages 返回当前包目录及安装命令，这正是助手选择正确包而非猜测名称的方式。当两个包覆盖相同领域（如追踪或数据库层）时，结果会附带选择规则，因为同时安装两者会静默失败而非报错。

scaffold_service 会根据您描述的方法签名生成符合规范的服务——包含 @expose() 装饰器的 JSDoc 类型方法的 IMQService 子类，以及启动它的引导代码。自定义返回类型会携带生成该类型所需的 @classType() 和 @property() 装饰器，这很重要，因为缺少这些装饰器的字段在生成的客户端中会被视为 any 类型但仍能编译通过。scaffold_client 展示如何生成和使用服务的类型客户端。两者均返回可审查和粘贴的源代码文本；均不会写入文件。

所有六个工具均为只读模式。该服务器不涉及账户、认证或存储：每个请求均无状态处理，它唯一可见的数据是您发送的参数——搜索查询、文档 URL 或服务名称。所有数据不会被保留，且不会收集或使用任何对话内容进行训练。

那些需要操作您本地机器的工具——如运行 imq CLI、在磁盘上创建项目、启动/停止服务、读取日志——被刻意排除在该服务器之外，因为托管服务器无法访问您的机器，也不应声称可以。这些功能包含在本地安装中（npx -y @imqueue/mcp），而 local_install_guide 返回其安装步骤。

payload.name: NORMS: Evidence & Scope
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: NORMS assesses whether structured, ratified normative records have sufficient verified grounds for a declared purpose. It checks explicit authority, temporal applicability, scope, verification, provision segmentation and structured conditions, then reports blockers, unknowns and unexamined areas. Missing or unverified required grounds fail closed. NORMS does not provide legal advice, certify compliance, parse PDFs or documents, retrieve laws, infer normative conditions from free text, approve contracts or modify external data.
payload.longDescription: NORMS评估经批准的规范性记录是否具备足够的验证依据以支持声明目的。它将检查明确授权、时间适用性、范围、验证情况、条款分割及结构化条件，并报告存在的障碍、未知领域和未核查区域。缺失或未验证的必要依据将导致失败。NORMS不提供法律建议、合规认证、PDF或文档解析、法律检索、从自由文本推断规范性条件、合同审批或外部数据修改。

payload.name: StubEngine
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
StubEngine helps companies speed up API delivery by turning plain-English requirements into live API mocks. Users can generate valid mock APIs and manage everything in a shared business workspace.
Whether you need a single mocked endpoint or a full API project with related endpoints, StubEngine makes it faster to prototype, test and ship integrations.
By reducing manual setup and accelerating mock creation, teams can move from idea to working API simulation in minutes.
payload.longDescription:
StubEngine通过将纯文本英文需求转化为实时API模拟，帮助公司加速API交付。用户可以生成有效的模拟API并在共享业务工作区中管理所有内容。
无论您需要单个模拟端点还是包含相关端点的完整API项目，StubEngine都能让您更快地进行原型设计、测试和发布集成。
通过减少手动设置并加速模拟创建，团队可以在几分钟内从想法实现工作中的API模拟。

payload.name: Agent Community
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Look up a known Agent Community member by exact name or slug, read the roughly-live community count, explicitly pre-register a proposed .agent identity, and verify live DMV certificate issuance. Broad directory search is intentionally unsupported. Pre-registration is free and non-binding, does not confer domain ownership, and the proposed .agent TLD remains pending ICANN approval.
payload.longDescription: 通过精确名称或别名查找已知的Agent Community成员，查看大致实时的社区成员数量，对拟议的.agent身份进行显式预注册，并验证实时DMV证书签发情况。有意不支持广泛的目录搜索功能。预注册免费且无约束力，不赋予域名所有权，且拟议的.agent顶级域仍需等待ICANN批准。

payload.name: SiteTriage
payload.summaryOriginal: Find out why a site is broken
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Your site just broke — ask SiteTriage why. Give it a URL or domain and it runs live, read-only diagnostics from the edge: DNS resolution and propagation, the exact TLS certificate the server is presenting right now (including TLS 1.3), HTTP status and redirect chains, email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and domain registration and expiry. It then returns the most likely root cause, ranked, with concrete fix steps — instead of guesses. Ideal for the deploy moment: apex-vs-www misconfigurations, stale DNS after a host migration, propagation lag, certificate errors, redirect loops, and emails landing in spam. Stateless and anonymous: no accounts, no stored data.
payload.longDescription: 您的网站突然无法访问——请SiteTriage帮您找出原因。输入一个URL或域名，它将从网络边缘执行实时只读诊断：DNS解析与传播情况、服务器当前展示的完整TLS证书（包括TLS 1.3）、HTTP状态码和重定向链、邮件认证机制（SPF、DKIM、DMARC）、域名注册信息及到期情况。随后会返回最可能的故障原因列表，并附上具体解决步骤——彻底告别猜测。特别适合部署时刻使用：域名解析配置错误（主域名与www子域名混淆）、迁移主机后的残留DNS记录、传播延迟、证书错误、重定向循环以及邮件被误判为垃圾邮件等问题。无状态且完全匿名：无需账户，不存储任何数据。

payload.name: omgskills
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover skills for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other coding agents from the omgskills public catalog. Search by task, inspect detailed metadata and installation instructions, browse trending and editorially selected skills, and explore skills from specific creators. omgskills is read-only: it helps people find and evaluate skills without installing or changing anything on their device.
payload.longDescription: 从 omgskills 公共目录中发现适用于 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 及其他编程代理的技能。通过任务搜索、查看详细元数据和安装说明、浏览热门及编辑精选技能、探索特定创作者的技能。omgskills 为只读模式：它帮助用户查找和评估技能，而无需在其设备上安装或更改任何内容。

payload.name: Alloy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Alloy connects ChatGPT to your organization's robot mission and Mesh Storage data. Search missions and images, inspect summaries, reports, scenarios, devices, and data-lake tables, run read-only analysis, create reports and artifacts, manage report automations, and perform approved device or edge-configuration actions.
payload.longDescription: Alloy 将 ChatGPT 连接到您组织的机器人任务和 Mesh Storage 数据。可搜索任务和图像，查看摘要、报告、场景、设备和数据湖表格，运行只读分析，创建报告和工件，管理报告自动化，并执行经过批准的设备或边缘配置操作。

payload.name: Noodle Seed
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access your Noodle Seed workspace in ChatGPT to find information faster, stay organized, and keep your work moving without switching tools.
payload.longDescription: 在ChatGPT中访问您的Noodle Seed工作区，以更快地查找信息，保持井井有条，并在不切换工具的情况下继续工作。

payload.name: zeroheight

payload.longDescription: zeroheight MCP可将ChatGPT直接连接至您的设计系统文档。让您的AI助手访问设计规范——组件、设计令牌、模式及使用规则——使其在生成代码或回答设计系统相关问题时，能够参考正确的指导原则。

payload.name: AI Task Brief Builder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn supplied development materials into evidence-based task goals, test requirements, and implementation briefs. The plugin separates confirmed requirements from unconfirmed suggestions, keeps scope and constraints clear, and identifies missing information without inventing requirements.
payload.longDescription: 将提供的开发材料转化为基于证据的任务目标、测试需求和实施简报。该插件能够区分已确认需求与未确认建议，明确范围和约束条件，并识别缺失信息而不会自行补充需求。

payload.name: Stele
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Stele gives AI agents a shared, persistent knowledge graph and task system for your projects. Capture decisions, architecture, lessons, and work once, then make that context available across ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, Cursor, and other MCP-compatible agents. Agents can find prior context, maintain project knowledge, and coordinate work without starting from scratch.
payload.longDescription: Stele为您的项目中的AI代理提供共享的、持久的知识图谱和任务系统。一次性记录决策、架构、经验及工作内容，随后将该上下文提供给ChatGPT、Codex、Claude、Cursor及其他MCP兼容的代理。代理可以查找先前的上下文、维护项目知识，并协调工作而无需从头开始。

payload.name: Opscotch
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Opscotch MCP Server gives AI assistants direct access to Opscotch knowledge and authoring tools.

The MCP server exposes structured tools that allow AI assistants to understand, author, validate, and work with Opscotch applications and workflows.

The server is designed for developers using AI coding assistants, and automation engineers who want to build or maintain Opscotch solutions using natural language.

An AI connected to the server can perform tasks such as:
- answer questions about the Opscotch platform
- explain APIs, configuration, and runtime behaviour
- author workflows and bootstrap configurations
- validate workflow structure and configuration
- assist with packaging, deployment, and licensing
- provide guidance using the latest platform capabilities
- generate examples and implementation patterns

With MCP, the AI can use purpose-built tools that understand the Opscotch platform, resulting in responses that are:

- more accurate
- aware of current platform features
- capable of structured authoring rather than just producing text
- less prone to hallucinating APIs or configuration

Typical use cases
- "Create a workflow that polls an HTTP endpoint every minute."
- "Why won't this bootstrap validate?"
- "Generate a workflow that receives webhooks and forwards them to AWS SQS."
- "Explain this JavaScript processor."
- "Help migrate this workflow to the latest Opscotch version."
- "Help me generate a signed package for deployment."

The server is intended for:

- AI coding assistants
- IDE integrations
- CLI agents
- automation developers
- DevOps and platform engineers
- custom AI applications that need authoritative knowledge of Opscotch
payload.longDescription:
Opscotch MCP服务器为AI助手提供对Opscotch知识库和创作工具的直接访问权限。

MCP服务器提供结构化工具，使AI助手能够理解、创作、验证并处理Opscotch应用程序和工作流。

该服务器专为使用AI编码助手的开发者，以及希望通过自然语言构建或维护Opscotch解决方案的自动化工程师设计。

连接到服务器的AI可以执行以下任务：
- 回答关于Opscotch平台的问题
- 解释API、配置和运行时行为
- 创作工作流和初始化配置
- 验证工作流结构和配置
- 协助打包、部署和许可
- 利用最新平台功能提供建议
- 生成示例和实现模式

通过MCP，AI可以使用专为理解Opscotch平台而设计的工具，从而获得以下结果：

- 更精确的响应
- 了解当前平台功能
- 具备结构化创作能力而非单纯生成文本
- 更少出现虚构API或配置的情况

典型使用场景
- "创建一个每分钟轮询HTTP端点的工作流。"

- "解释这个JavaScript处理器。"
- "帮助将此工作流迁移到最新版Opscotch。"
- "帮我生成用于部署的签名包。"

该服务器适用于：

- AI编码助手
- IDE集成
- CLI代理
- 自动化开发人员
- DevOps和平台工程师
- 需要权威Opscotch知识的定制AI应用

payload.name: MGS Agile Toolkit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Access to expert, 24x7 Scrum and agile coaching, expert level user story splitting, product backlog item generation and access to your Mountain Goat Software video course library, right inside ChatGPT.

可随时访问专家级Scrum和敏捷指导服务，专家级别的用户故事拆分、产品待办事项生成，并可访问您的Mountain Goat Software视频课程库，直接集成在ChatGPT中。

payload.name: ConsentLayer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ConsentLayer helps website owners set up and manage GDPR, CCPA, and LGPD cookie consent through ChatGPT. It can provision a site, scan for tracking technologies, configure consent categories and banner behavior, generate installation snippets, verify a live installation, and manage ongoing compliance workflows such as scanner reviews, geolocation rules, cookie policies, and Do Not Sell requests.
payload.longDescription: ConsentLayer通过ChatGPT帮助网站所有者设置和管理GDPR、CCPA及LGPD的Cookie同意策略。该工具可配置网站、扫描追踪技术、设置同意分类与横幅行为、生成安装代码片段、验证实时部署情况，并管理持续合规流程，包括扫描器审查、地理位置规则、Cookie政策以及'不要出售我的个人信息'请求处理。

payload.name: API Impact Mapper
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Extract explicit API changes, classify breaking changes, and map evidence-based impacts across consumers, tests, and documentation. Uses only the facts supplied by the user and does not access external systems.
payload.longDescription: 提取明确的API变更，分类破坏性变更，并在消费者、测试用例和文档中映射基于证据的影响。仅使用用户提供的事实，不访问外部系统。

payload.name: zyberspace
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ZyberSpace lets you create and publish professional business websites in minutes. Describe your business, choose your style, and ZyberSpace turns it into a live, mobile and agent-ready website.

Go beyond basic online presence. With ZyberSpace, local businesses can launch service pages, landing pages, lead-generation sites, portfolios, restaurant pages, salon websites, contractor websites, and small business websites designed to attract customers.

payload.name: DocRunic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect DocRunic to ChatGPT to work with documentation in your authorized workspaces. Search and browse pages, read current content and version history, inspect page structures and attachment metadata, create or update drafts, and publish documentation when requested.

payload.longDescription:
将DocRunic连接至ChatGPT，在授权的工作空间中处理文档。支持搜索浏览页面、阅读当前内容与版本历史、检查页面结构及附件元数据、创建或更新草稿，并在需要时发布文档。

payload.name: IDrive e2

payload.longDescription: 通过自然语言提示连接您的IDrive e2账户，浏览区域、管理存储桶和对象、配置生命周期及对象锁定设置，并生成预签名链接。

payload.name: Camber

payload.longDescription: Camber允许用户在ChatGPT内部直接管理账户和工作区、发现或创建代理，并启动和监控代理运行。

payload.name: NPMScan
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Look up npm package metadata, known vulnerabilities, and CVE details directly from a conversation. NPMScan's MCP server gives AI agents read-only tools backed by the npm registry, OSV.dev, GitHub Security Advisories, GitHub's own API, and the NIST National Vulnerability Database: search packages by name or keyword with download counts, dependent-package counts, and typosquat detection on every result; inspect a package's install scripts, maintainers, license, GitHub stars, and download trend before installing, or compare 2-5 candidates side-by-side with a deterministic pick; check an exact version pinned in a lockfile, or simulate upgrading one before running npm install to see if it's a safe patch or a likely-breaking major bump; query vulnerabilities for one package or up to 100 at once, each finding enriched with severity, a summary, CVE aliases, and the fixed version rather than a bare advisory ID; audit an entire GitHub repository's dependencies (including monorepo workspaces) in one call, or generate a spec-valid CycloneDX/SPDX SBOM with vulnerability and license data embedded; rank the findings from a raw `npm audit --json` report by CISA KEV/FIRST EPSS exploitation data to know what to fix first, then pull the concrete, ordered remediation playbook for a flagged finding; check an npm maintainer account's publish history for a compromised-account-style cluster, or pull their basic profile; browse the latest npm advisories from either GitHub's curated, mostly CVE-backed reviewed set or its known-malicious-package malware feed, filterable by severity, vulnerability category (XSS, SQL/NoSQL Injection, SSRF, Access Control, Code Injection, and 15 more, reviewed only), affected package, or an exact GHSA/CVE ID; and look up authoritative CVSS/CWE data for any CVE across any ecosystem, enriched with CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities status and FIRST.org's EPSS exploitation-probability score. No API key or authentication is required, and every result links back to the full write-up on npmscan.com.
payload.longDescription: 直接通过对话查询npm包元数据、已知漏洞和CVE详情。NPMScan的MCP服务器为AI代理提供只读工具，这些工具依托于npm注册表、OSV.dev、GitHub安全公告、GitHub自身API以及NIST国家漏洞数据库：可通过包名或关键词搜索，结果包含下载量、依赖包数量及拼写错误检测；查看包的安装脚本、维护者、许可证、GitHub星标和下载趋势后再安装，或通过确定性选择并排比较2-5个候选包；检查锁文件中精确版本或模拟升级前的版本，查看是否为安全补丁或可能引发中断的主版本更新；一次查询单个包或最多100个包的漏洞信息，每个发现均包含严重程度、摘要、CVE别名和修复版本而非原始公告ID；一次审计整个GitHub仓库的依赖关系（包括单仓库工作区），或生成包含漏洞和许可证数据的符合规范的CycloneDX/SPDX SBOM；根据CISA KEV/FIRST EPSS利用数据对原始npm audit --json报告中的发现进行排序，确定优先修复项，然后获取被标记发现的具体修复方案；检查npm维护者账户的发布记录是否存在账户被入侵式集群，或获取其基础资料；浏览来自GitHub精选的、主要基于CVE审核的公告或其已知恶意包恶意软件源，可按严重程度、漏洞类别（XSS、SQL/NoSQL注入、SSRF、访问控制、代码注入等15种以上类别，仅审核）、受影响包或具体GHSA/CVE ID过滤；查询任何CVE的权威CVSS/CWE数据，包含CISA已知利用漏洞状态和FIRST.org的EPSS利用概率评分。无需API密钥或身份验证，每个结果都会链接到npmscan.com上的完整文章。

payload.name: BasicDeploy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

Through the connector, the assistant can create containers, deploy a project, run shell commands, and read logs. You can also add hosted sign-up and login to the apps you build over standard OpenID Connect, so your app gets its own users without writing an auth system. You sign in once with your BasicDeploy account — no API key to paste. Pricing is a flat monthly rate that includes the database, storage, bandwidth, and URL.
payload.longDescription:
BasicDeploy让你的助手能够为网络应用创建实时容器，向其中部署代码并进行管理——所有操作均可通过聊天完成。每个应用均自动配置PostgreSQL数据库、兼容S3的对象存储、环境变量以及公共HTTPS网址。

通过连接器，助手可以创建容器、部署项目、运行shell命令并查看日志。你还可以通过标准OpenID Connect为所构建的应用添加托管注册和登录功能，这样你的应用即可拥有独立用户体系而无需自行开发认证系统。使用BasicDeploy账户一键登录即可——无需粘贴API密钥。定价采用固定月费制，包含数据库、存储空间、流量和网址费用。

payload.name: PR Readiness Check
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Analyzes supplied pull request materials for change evidence, requirement alignment, testing, risks, rollback, and readiness for human review. It does not access repositories, run tests, approve, or merge pull requests.

payload.name: Prism by Crossdeck

payload.name: mittwald
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manage your mittwald (mStudio) hosting infrastructure from ChatGPT. List and inspect projects, apps, servers and domains; provision and manage MySQL and Redis databases, users, backups and backup schedules; work with containers, stacks, cron jobs and volumes; configure domains, DNS zones, virtual hosts, SSL certificates and mail addresses; manage organization and project members, SSH users and keys, and API tokens. Read-only tools inspect resources, while write tools create, update or remove them on the authenticated user's behalf.
payload.longDescription: 从ChatGPT管理您的mittwald（mStudio）托管基础设施。列出并检查项目、应用、服务器和域名；配置和管理MySQL及Redis数据库、用户、备份及备份计划；操作容器、堆栈、定时任务和卷；配置域名、DNS区域、虚拟主机、SSL证书和邮件地址；管理组织及项目成员、SSH用户和密钥、API令牌。只读工具用于检查资源，而写入工具则代表已认证用户创建、更新或删除资源。

payload.name: Flyte
payload.description: 作者, 迁移, 运行, 调试
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Author, run, and deploy Flyte 2 workflows, apps, and agents with skills grounded in the Flyte SDK and documentation. In ChatGPT web, search Flyte docs and SDK examples. In a local ChatGPT environment with the Flyte CLI configured, run and manage your authenticated Flyte cluster.
payload.longDescription: 创建、运行和部署 Flyte 2 工作流程、应用程序和代理,并具备在 Flyte SDK 和文档中建立的技能。在 ChatGPT 网站上,搜索 Flyte 文档和 SDK 示例。

payload.name: Lumen UI
payload.description: 使用 Lumen 构建接口
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lumen UI helps coding agents build accessible interfaces from a real multi-framework design-system contract. Search the component catalog, retrieve framework-specific usage and source, inspect web and native recipes, read semantic tokens, and follow the bundled Lumen workflow for Astro, React, Web Components, React Native, SwiftUI, and Jetpack Compose.
payload.longDescription: Lumen UI有助于编码代理从真正的多框架设计系统合同中构建可访问的接口. 搜索组件目录,检索框架特定的使用和源,检查Web和原生食谱,阅读语义代码,并跟踪Bundled Lumen工作流程为Astro,React,Web Components,React Native,SwiftUI和Jetpack Compose。

payload.name: Resolve AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect ChatGPT and Codex to Resolve AI. Start and steer investigations, pull live production context, and turn root-cause findings into pull requests.
The Resolve plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to Resolve AI over MCP. Resolve's agents join your on-call rotations to triage and investigate alerts and work alongside engineers to reach root cause faster; this plugin brings that surface directly into your coding agent so you can act on it where you already code.
It installs skills for listing and filtering alerts, reading and summarizing investigations, starting new root-cause analyses, asking follow-up questions, steering an active investigation with context you have locally, pulling an area's production profile before a risky change, and translating findings into local code changes and a PR.
payload.longDescription: 连接 ChatGPT 和 Codex 来解决 AI. 启动和控制调查,拉动实时生产背景,并将根因发现转化为拉动请求。 Resolve 插件连接 ChatGPT 和 Codex 来解决 AI 通过 MCP。 Resolve 的代理人加入您的呼叫旋转来分类和调查警报,并与工程师一起更快地达到根因原因; 这个插件将该表面直接带入您的编码代理,以便您可以在您已经编码的地方采取行动。 它安装了列表和过滤警报的技能,阅读和总结调查,开始新的根因分析,询问后续问题,指导与您在本地的背景下进行积极调查,在风险变更之前拉动区域的生产资料,并将结果翻译成本地代码变更和PR。

payload.name: HTML/CSS to Image API
payload.description: HTML 到 图像 & URL 屏幕截图
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The HTML/CSS to Image MCP server lets AI assistants create production-ready images, website screenshots, and PDFs through natural-language instructions.

Use it to:

- Render HTML and CSS into PNG, JPG, WebP, or PDF
- Capture screenshots of public URLs
- Generate images from reusable templates and variables
- Create batches of multiple image variations
- Create, update, list, and version image templates
- Configure viewport size, device scale, selectors, render delays, and other rendering options
payload.longDescription:
HTML/CSS to Image MCP 服务器允许 AI 助手通过自然语言指令创建生产准备的图像、网站屏幕截图和 PDF。

用它来:

- 将HTML和CSS转换为PNG、JPG、WebP或PDF - 捕捉公共URL的屏幕截图 - 通过可重复使用的模板和变量生成图像 - 创建多个图像变异的批量 - 创建、更新、列表和版本图像模板 - 配置视图端口大小、设备规模、选择器、渲染延迟和其他渲染选项

payload.name: HOME AI Node
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HOME AI Node lets ChatGPT inspect the health, runtime state, and tracked tasks of a HOME AI node. get_node_status reports whether a node is online and its repository state, get_runtime_state shows the runtime mode and MCP protocol, and get_task_status queries task progress. In this phase the server is backed by a deterministic synthetic review fixture (node review-demo-node) so reviewers can exercise every tool without any private network access; connection to a real HOME AI node is a later phase behind an authorized-user boundary (OAuth). All operations are strictly read-only: nothing on this server can write, execute, or reach any private network.
payload.longDescription: HOME AI Node 允许 ChatGPT 检查 HOME AI 节点的健康、运行状态和追踪任务. get_node_status 报告节点是否在线及其存储状态, get_runtime_state 显示了运行模式和 MCP 协议,以及 get_task_status 查询了任务进度。在此阶段,服务器受到了确定性合成审查固定(节点审查 - 演示节点)的支持,因此审查员可以使用每个工具而无需任何私人网络访问;连接到真正的 HOME AI 节点是授权用户边界(OAuth)背后的后一个阶段。

payload.name: Knock
payload.description: 通过频道传达用户信息
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Knock is agent-first customer engagement infrastructure for your product, marketing, and transactional messaging. One platform to manage all your messaging across email, SMS, push, chat, and in-app.

Inspect workflows and manage notifications, directly in ChatGPT and Codex.
payload.longDescription:
Knock 是您产品、营销和交易消息的代理第一客户互动基础设施. 一个平台来管理您在电子邮件、短信、推送、聊天和应用中的所有消息。

检查工作流程和管理通知,直接在ChatGPT和Codex中。

payload.name: Suger
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Suger helps marketplace teams work with cloud marketplace, CRM, co-sell, integration, billing, and knowledge data in ChatGPT. Users can look up offers, buyers, entitlements, referrals, integrations, workflow runs, CRM records, and support knowledge, and perform enabled actions through their connected Suger organization.
payload.longDescription: Suger 帮助市场团队在 ChatGPT 中使用云市场、CRM、共同销售、集成、发票和知识数据工作,用户可以搜索报价、购买者、权限、引用、集成、工作流程、CRM 记录和支持知识,并通过其连接的 Suger 组织执行启用操作。

payload.name: Uizze
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Uizze gives coding agents a free anti-ui-slop Skill and optional full MCP access to live UI references, license-clear materials, and rendered safety checks. Use the skill to inspect the product and design system, write a design contract, cover required states, and run a bounded finish gate. The MCP answers one concrete unresolved UI question with strong full-screen references, finds license-clear materials for a concrete role, or optionally checks rendered UI for observable breakage, accessibility, privacy, and task-blocking composition. The free preview MCP exposes a deterministic source check only.
payload.longDescription: Uizze为编码代理提供免费的反ui-slop 技能和可选的完整 MCP 访问权限,以实时 UI 参考、许可证清晰材料和渲染安全检查。使用该技能来检查产品和设计系统,撰写设计合同,覆盖所需状态,并运行有限的终端门口。MCP 用强大的全屏引用来回答一个具体未解决的 UI 问题,为具体角色找到许可证清晰的材料,或者可选地检查渲染的 UI 可观察破坏、可访问性、隐私和任务阻止组成。

payload.name: TALON Knowledge
payload.description: 搜索 TALON 手册, Q&A
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
A connector that lets AI agents search the official knowledge base of TALON, a low-code platform for building business applications. It searches thousands of pages of official manuals, support Q&A, a database of 900+ real-world function configuration examples, and specification analyses, and returns answers with source URLs as evidence. Typical uses include feature design consultation, configuration value lookups, error-cause investigation, browsing similar real-world examples, and automated validation of generated settings.

A TALON maintenance contract and a TALON support site (Zendesk) account are required. Users authenticate by signing in to the support site when connecting. All tools are read-only, and users' conversation content, code, and attachments are never sent to our servers (details: https://mcp.talon.jp/privacy).
payload.longDescription:
该连接器允许AI代理商搜索TALON的官方知识库,这是一个低代码的商业应用程序构建平台,它搜索了数千页的官方手册,支持Q&A,拥有900多个真实世界函数配置示例和规格分析的数据库,并以源URL作为证据返回答案。

需要TALON维护合同和TALON支持站点(Zendesk)帐户。用户在连接时通过登录到支持站点进行身份验证。所有工具只能读取,用户的对话内容、代码和附件永远不会发送到我们的服务器(详细信息: https://mcp.talon.jp/privacy)。

payload.name: Craftian
payload.description: 创建功能齐全的Web应用程序
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create fully working business software and web apps from a prompt. With Craftian you can create CRMs, task managers, inventory systems, expense trackers, time trackers, job portals, on-boarding portals, data forms etc.

Craftian creates production-ready web apps with built-in database, authentication, role-based access control, file storage, and automatic cloud deployment.

No coding experience required. Just describe what you want, and keep refining it.
payload.longDescription:
通过Craftian,您可以创建CRM,任务经理,库存系统,支出跟踪器,时间跟踪器,工作门户,登机门户,数据表格等。

Craftian 创建了生产准备的 Web 应用程序,包括内置的数据库、身份验证、基于角色的访问控制、文件存储和自动云部署。

无需编码经验,只需描述你想要的内容,并继续改进。

payload.name: FluxBuilder
payload.description: 创建电子商务应用程序
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect to the FluxBuilder MCP server to manage native Flutter app projects for WooCommerce, Shopify, and WordPress. Easily create apps, redesign screens, update settings, search store catalogs, capture mobile previews, and run test or release builds for the App Store, Google Play, and web—all without writing code.
payload.longDescription: 连接到 FluxBuilder MCP 服务器,以管理 WooCommerce、Shopify 和 WordPress 的本地 Flutter 应用程序项目. 轻松创建应用程序、重新设计屏幕、更新设置、搜索商店目录、捕捉移动预览,并为 App Store、Google Play 和 Web 运行测试或发布构建,而无需编写代码。

payload.name: Sleuth Skills
payload.description: 在聊天中使用你的自定义技能
payload.summaryOriginal: Use your custom skills in chat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sleuth Skills connects ChatGPT to your personal skills.new vault — a private collection of skills, rules, agents, and slash commands you've authored or saved. The app lets ChatGPT discover what's in your vault and load the full content of a specific skill on demand, so conversations can follow your own playbooks instead of relying on generic knowledge. It is read-only: it never modifies, deletes, or shares your vault content.
payload.longDescription: Sleuth Skills 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的个人技能中。新保险箱 - 您所撰写或保存的技能、规则、代理和削减命令的私人集合. 该应用程序允许 ChatGPT 发现您的保险箱中的内容,并根据需求加载特定技能的全部内容,以便对话可以跟随您自己的玩本,而不是依赖于通用知识。

payload.name: Dependency Upgrade Plan
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Creates evidence-based dependency upgrade preparation plans from supplied release, usage, testing, and rollback materials. It does not modify repositories, execute upgrades, run tests, commit changes, or create pull requests.
payload.longDescription: 通过提供的发布、使用、测试和反馈材料创建基于证据的依赖升级准备计划. 它不修改存储库、执行升级、运行测试、做出更改或创建拉动请求。

payload.name: EzzyBills
payload.description: 使用 EzzyBills API 构建应用程序
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access the authoritative EzzyBills developer specification, REST API contracts, authentication models, and integration guidance for building EzzyBills applications such as approval dashboards, email response workflows, and purchase order tools.
payload.longDescription: 获取权威的 EzzyBills 开发人员规范、 REST API 合同、身份验证模型和集成指南,用于构建 EzzyBills 应用程序,如批准仪表板、电子邮件响应工作流程和采购订单工具。

payload.name: Control Plane
payload.description: 部署和运行云应用程序
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Control Plane runs containerized apps across AWS, GCP, Azure, Oracle Cloud, and your own hardware as one platform. Build a GitHub or a GitLab repo into a container and deploy it to a live HTTPS URL, give it a custom domain, attach Postgres or Redis, and let it autoscale. Diagnose failures from logs, metrics, and events, and find the over-provisioned workloads inflating your cloud bill.
payload.longDescription: Control Plane 可在 AWS、GCP、Azure、Oracle Cloud 和您自己的硬件上运行容器化应用程序,作为一个平台。将 GitHub 或 GitLab 复制器构建成容器,并部署到实时 HTTPS URL,给它定制域名,附加 Postgres 或 Redis,并让它自动扩展。

payload.name: Birdie
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Birdie helps you capture customer issues and turn them into clear context for troubleshooting.

Instead of relying on written descriptions, customers can record their screen to show the issue. Birdie captures the full context, including what happened, what they clicked, and technical evidence such as console logs, network requests, session data, device metadata, and reproduction steps.

This gives your agent the context it needs to understand the issue, troubleshoot it accurately, and move faster to a resolution.

With Birdie, your agent does not have to guess what the customer meant. It can see what the customer saw and use the right evidence to investigate the issue.

Built for support and technical teams, Birdie reduces back and forth and helps both humans and AI troubleshoot customer issues faster.
payload.longDescription:
Birdie 帮助您捕捉客户问题,并将其转化为清晰的故障排除环境。

Birdie捕捉了整个背景,包括发生了什么,他们点击了什么,以及技术证据,如控制台日志,网络请求,会话数据,设备元数据和复制步骤。

这为您的代理提供必要的背景,以了解问题,准确地解决问题,并更快地解决问题。

有了 Birdie,你的代理人不必猜测客户的意思,它可以看到客户看到的内容,并使用正确的证据来调查问题。

由支持和技术团队构建,Birdie可以减少前进和后退,并帮助人类和AI更快地解决客户的问题。

payload.name: Test Failure Triage
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn supplied test output into a clear failure list, evidence-based classifications, and an investigation order. The plugin works only from the information you provide and does not access code, CI systems, repositories, or external services.
payload.longDescription: 将提供的测试输出转换为清晰的故障列表,基于证据的分类和调查命令. 该插件只从您提供的信息中工作,不访问代码,CI系统,存储库或外部服务。

payload.name: BitsWeave
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bitsweave is a user-owned context layer for AI tools. It stores the structured work of your organization, connects it via a context graph and exposes it to Claude over MCP.

Sign in with OAuth. ChatGPT can search and hydrate your org context so you do not repeat who you are, what the project is, or what you already decided.

What you can do:
• Look up a specific fact about your company, a past decision, or a current task.
• Ask a synthesis question across decisions, notes, and related records.
• Create or update a Bitsweave record from the conversation when you want the result stored.

Connect GitHub, email, and other tools through Bitsweave brokers when you enable them. Claude calls Bitsweave. Bitsweave uses the permissions you granted. The agent does not hold the upstream credentials.

Sign-in is required. The connector URL is https://bitsweave.com/api/mcp.

Setup: add Bitsweave, complete the OAuth sign-in, then ask ChatGPT to search your context or create a record. Public docs: https://bitsweave.com/docs/use/onboarding/connect-your-agents
payload.longDescription:
Bitsweave 是用于 AI 工具的用户专有的背景层,它存储您的组织的结构化工作,通过背景图进行连接,并通过 MCP 向 Claude 曝光。

ChatGPT可以搜索和水化您的 org 背景,以便您不要重复您是谁,项目是什么,或您已经决定了什么。

您可以做些什么: • 查找有关您的公司,过去的决定或当前任务的特定事实 • 通过决策,笔记和相关记录提出合成问题 • 创建或更新对话中的 Bitsweave 记录,当您希望结果存储时。

通过Bitsweave经纪人连接GitHub、电子邮件和其他工具,当您启用它们时,Claude会打电话给Bitsweave。Bitsweave使用您授予的权限。

需要登录. 连接器的 URL 是 https://bitsweave.com/api/mcp。

设置:添加Bitsweave,完成OAuth登录,然后请ChatGPT搜索您的背景或创建记录。公共文件: https://bitsweave.com/docs/use/onboarding/connect-your-agents

payload.name: Prefect
payload.description: 检查 Prefect 工作流程
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Prefect Cloud to inspect workflows, diagnose failed, late, or stuck runs, review workspace and worker health, and search current Prefect documentation and release notes. The hosted tools are read-only.
payload.longDescription: 连接 Prefect Cloud 以检查工作流程,诊断失败、延迟或停机运行,查看工作区和工人的健康状况,并搜索当前的 Prefect 文档和发布笔记。

payload.name: Vynix

Vynix MCP brings visual website feedback into ChatGPT so teams can fix issues with full context instead of guesswork. It lets ChatGPT access projects, annotations, comments, screenshots, and AI diagnosis data, then help you prioritize, investigate, and resolve work quickly. Teams can update annotation status, add comments, create GitHub issues, and generate share links from one workflow.

Built for product, engineering, and QA teams, Vynix MCP reduces back-and-forth by connecting discussion and implementation in one place.
payload.longDescription:
Vynix MCP 将视觉网站反馈带入 ChatGPT,以便团队可以用完整的背景解决问题,而不是猜测。它允许 ChatGPT 访问项目、注释、评论、屏幕截图和人工智能诊断数据,然后帮助您优先考虑、调查和快速解决工作。

Vynix MCP 专为产品、工程和 QA 团队而设计,通过将讨论和实施连接到一个地方来减少后退。

payload.name: NeuronSearchLab
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Inspect and manage your NeuronSearchLab recommendation workspace from ChatGPT. Search catalogue items, understand rankings, configure contexts, pipelines, rules and segments, run experiments and model training, and review performance analytics.
payload.longDescription: 从 ChatGPT 检查和管理您的 NeuronSearchLab 推荐工作区. 搜索目录项目,了解排名,配置背景,管道,规则和细分,运行实验和模型培训,并审查性能分析。

payload.name: Extend

Build and test reusable extractors, classifiers, and workflows on real documents, then run them at scale in your Extend workspace.
payload.longDescription: 从聊天中分析、提取、分类和分割文档:从 PDF、图像、Office 文件和表格中提取字段、表格和行项目,识别文档类型,将包分成单独的文档,并填写 PDF 表格。

payload.name: Relewise Developer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build, review, and troubleshoot Relewise Search, Recommendations, behavioral tracking, and data integrations with current API and SDK guidance for C#, TypeScript/JavaScript, PHP, and Java.
payload.longDescription: 使用当前的 API 和 SDK 指南构建、审查和故障排除 Relewise 搜索、推荐、行为跟踪和数据集成,用于 C#、TypeScript/JavaScript、PHP 和 Java。

payload.name: MCP Conduct Register
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
This plugin exposes a public register of measured conduct for MCP servers.

Five conditions are measured on a schedule: the server speaks MCP, it publishes an A2A agent card, it declares who pays it, identical input returns identical output, and the verdict itself can be recomputed by a third party. A condition that could not be measured is recorded as not measured. It is never counted as a pass, and that rule is not relaxed for the operator of the register.

The register does not rank servers. It does not recommend one server over another. It returns what was measured, when it was measured, and the SHA-256 of the record so that the reading can be checked by someone who does not trust the party that issued it.

An endpoint that is absent from the register has simply never been measured here. Absence is reported as absence and is not a negative verdict.

Determinism is not measured unless the owner of the checked server has recorded consent, because measuring it requires executing a tool on someone else's server.

Free, read only, no account and no key. The register is a build artefact of a scheduled script with no editorial step, and it is archived with a DOI so a citation survives the repository moving.
payload.longDescription:
此插件暴露了 MCP 服务器的测量行为的公共记录。

在一个时间表上测量五个条件:服务器说MCP,它发布A2A代理卡,它宣布谁支付它,相同的输入返回相同的输出,而判决本身可以由第三方重新计算。

该注册表不评级服务器. 它不建议一个服务器超过另一个服务器. 它返回了被测量的值,当它被测量时,以及记录的 SHA-256 以便读取可以由不信任发行者的某人检查。

一个缺席的终点从来没有在这里被测量过,缺席被报告为缺席,而不是负面判决。

确定性不会被测量,除非被检查的服务器的所有者已经记录了同意,因为测量它需要在别人的服务器上执行工具。

免费,只读,没有帐户和没有密钥. 该注册表是没有编辑步骤的日程脚本的构建文物,并以 DOI 进行档案,以便引用能够存活存储器的移动。

payload.name: Kody
payload.description: 将代理工作转化为软件
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Kody turns successful work in ChatGPT into durable, user-owned software. ChatGPT can use Kody to find the user's available capabilities and turn working solutions into reusable packages, schedules, webhooks, portable memories, and secret-backed connections. Credentials remain server-side, installed community packages are forked into the user's account, and saved workflows can run later without another model call. The same user-owned artifacts remain available across MCP-capable agents.
payload.longDescription: Kody 将 ChatGPT 中的成功工作转化为持久的用户所有软件。 ChatGPT 可以使用 Kody 找到用户可用的功能,并将工作解决方案转化为可重复使用的包、日程表、网页夹、便携式内存和秘密连接。

payload.name: MijnSpel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MijnSpel helps board game designers create and refine playable prototypes in Creator or Studio, validate project files, preview gameplay, run balance simulations, compare results, and publish a confirmed project to the web.
payload.longDescription: MijnSpel帮助游戏设计师在Creator或Studio中创建和改进可播放的原型,验证项目文件,预览游戏,运行平衡模拟,比较结果,并在网络上发布确认的项目。

payload.name: Stem
payload.description: 将你的AI连接到一个大脑。
payload.summaryOriginal: Connect your AI to one brain.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Stem is a persistent cross-AI memory. Connect it once and ChatGPT can store distilled memories (decisions, facts, preferences, project context), recall the most relevant ones in any future chat, link related ideas into a typed knowledge graph, and see it all visualized at awase.dev/stem. The same memory is available to every MCP-compatible tool the user connects, so context never has to be re-explained. Free tier included; storage tiers are opt-in.
payload.longDescription: Stem是一个持久的跨AI内存。连接一次,ChatGPT可以存储蒸的记忆(决策,事实,偏好,项目背景),记住任何未来的聊天中最相关的记忆,将相关的想法链接到一个键入的知识图表中,并在 awase.dev/stem 上查看所有可视化。

payload.name: QA Wolf
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to QA Wolf to inspect authorized workspaces, explore a staging app in a cloud browser, request test implementation from QA Wolf AI, run existing tests and review results. Follow live session links and verify validation, publication and draft or active readiness separately. Tools also manage test configuration, flow tags, issues, scheduled or deployment triggers, and workspace test email. A QA Wolf account with the required workspace permissions is needed. Runner and AI work can incur charges, and test actions can change the application under test. Connected integrations can publish code or send messages.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 QA Wolf 来检查授权的工作区,在云浏览器中探索舞台应用程序,向 QA Wolf AI 请求测试实施,运行现有测试和审查结果。 遵循现场会话链接并单独验证验证、发布和草案或活跃准备状态。 工具还管理测试配置、流程标签、问题、计划或部署触发器和工作区测试电子邮件。 需要 QA Wolf 帐户,具有所需的工作区权限。

payload.name: Hyperhuman Agent Workspace
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Work with Hyperhuman fitness content directly in ChatGPT. Explore sample workouts, review structured workout data, inspect exercise flows and media, and generate copy-ready API or embed snippets for web and mobile apps. Sign in with Hyperhuman Teams to browse your workspace content, manage workouts, programs, exercises, and social drops, and run selected content workflows through chat.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中使用 Hyperhuman 健身内容。 探索样本训练,查看结构化训练数据,检查锻炼流程和媒体,并生成 Web 和移动应用程序的备份 API 或嵌入式片段。 登录 Hyperhuman 团队以浏览您的工作空间内容,管理锻炼、程序、练习和社交流程,并通过聊天运行选定的内容工作流程。

payload.name: Panderr
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring an existing website into Panderr to preserve, improve, or redesign it. Start with the website you already have, migrate its pages and content, then continue editing and managing the site in Panderr.
payload.longDescription: 将现有网站带到 Panderr 以便保存、改进或重新设计,从您已经拥有的网站开始,迁移其页面和内容,然后继续在 Panderr 中编辑和管理该网站。

payload.name: FreakUI
payload.description: 具有 FreakUI 的原生 Apple 应用程序
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build a single-target, multi-platform native Swift application for iPhone, iPad, and macOS from one prompt. FreakUI establishes a robust clean architecture foundation with dependency injection, programmatic navigation, MVVM, and platform-specific root views. Its custom theme initialization, precision-focused components, utilities, and extensions give the interface a distinct and consistent identity. Beyond project creation, dedicated FreakUI skills help shape interface sections, add components, and evolve the interface as the app grows.
payload.longDescription: 通过一个提示,为 iPhone、iPad 和 macOS 构建一个单一目标、多平台的原生 Swift 应用程序 FreakUI 建立了强大的清洁架构基础,具有依赖注入、编程导航、MVVM 和平台特定的 root 视图。其自定义主题初始化、精密聚焦的组件、实用工具和扩展为接口提供了独特和一致的身份。
